title: AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect Wins 2026 Conversational AI Excellence Award
summary: Can your AI agent deliver beyond the demo? Discover the real business challenge behind AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect’s 2026 Conversational AI Excellence Award.
body_markdown:
AudioCodes is celebrating another milestone in enterprise voice AI. The **AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect** solution has been named a winner of the **2026 Conversational AI Excellence Award** , presented by TMC’s *CUSTOMER* magazine, recognizing its contribution to making intelligent, natural voice interactions a practical reality for businesses.


The award, officially announced on October 13, 2026, recognizes technologies that help organizations improve customer engagement, streamline operations and deliver meaningful business outcomes through conversational AI. 1


For AudioCodes, this recognition reflects a central belief. The real value of conversational AI comes not simply from building intelligent agents, but from making them accessible through the communication channels customers already use.


## Why This Recognition Matters


Conversational AI is entering a new phase. Businesses are moving beyond experimenting with AI assistants and exploring how intelligent agents can become part of everyday customer interactions.


According to McKinsey’s 2025 State of AI report, 88% of organizations use AI in at least one business function. Yet only 7% report having fully scaled AI across their organizations. 2


The gap between AI adoption and operational deployment remains significant.


For voice AI, closing that gap requires more than sophisticated language models. Businesses need reliable connections between AI applications, enterprise telephony systems and the customers who depend on them. This is precisely the challenge that[VoiceAI Connect](https://voiceaiconnect.audiocodes.com/) was designed to address.


## Bringing Conversational AI to Enterprise Voice


VoiceAI Connect enables organizations to connect conversational AI applications and voicebots to existing telephony and contact center environments. Rather than requiring businesses to replace established communications infrastructure, VoiceAI Connect provides the integration layer that allows AI-powered conversations to take place over familiar voice channels.


This opens up practical opportunities for enterprises to introduce intelligent voice automation into everyday operations, including:


-


**Intelligent customer self-service** : Enable customers to interact naturally with AI-powered voice assistants instead of navigating rigid phone menus.


-


**Automated routine inquiries** : Handle common requests through conversational AI, allowing human agents to focus on interactions that need their expertise.


-


**Flexible AI integration** : Connect conversational AI applications with existing enterprise voice environments while protecting communications investments.


-


**Scalable customer engagement** : Extend the availability of voice-based assistance to support changing customer demand.


The business benefit extends beyond automation. By making AI accessible through the telephone, organizations can improve responsiveness while preserving the human support customers need for more complex conversations.


## Turning Voice AI Innovation Into Business Value


The 2026 Conversational AI Excellence Awards highlight an important shift in the industry. In its official announcement, TMC emphasized that conversational AI is increasingly being used to solve customer problems, complete transactions and support meaningful business outcomes. 3


For enterprises, this changes how conversational AI investments should be evaluated. The important question is no longer simply whether an AI agent can understand a customer’s request. It’s whether that agent can participate effectively in a real business interaction – which requires dependable voice connectivity, integration with existing systems and the flexibility to support different conversational AI technologies.


AudioCodes brings decades of enterprise voice experience to this challenge. VoiceAI Connect builds on that expertise, helping organizations bridge the gap between AI innovation and established communications environments. It also reflects AudioCodes’ broader commitment to helping organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation, whether human or AI, into a strategic asset that drives better business outcomes.


## Celebrating the Teams Behind the Technology


Winning the 2026 Conversational AI Excellence Award is an important recognition for the AudioCodes teams developing and supporting VoiceAI Connect. It reflects the work involved in making advanced conversational AI technologies usable within real enterprise environments, where reliability, interoperability and customer experience matter just as much as AI capabilities.


AudioCodes is proud to be included among this year’s award recipients and appreciates the recognition from TMC and *CUSTOMER* magazine. Most importantly, this achievement reinforces the company’s commitment to helping enterprises and partners bring practical voice AI applications into everyday business communications.

###


[AudioCodes VoiceAI Connect](https://voiceaiconnect.audiocodes.com/) received a 2026 Conversational AI Excellence Award presented by TMC’s *CUSTOMER* magazine. The award recognizes technologies and applications contributing to conversational AI innovation and business impact.


###


[VoiceAI Connect](https://voiceaiconnect.audiocodes.com/) is an AudioCodes solution that connects conversational AI applications and voicebots to enterprise telephony and contact center environments, allowing organizations to introduce AI-powered voice interactions through existing communications infrastructure.


###


VoiceAI Connect helps organizations introduce conversational AI without unnecessarily replacing existing voice systems. It enables intelligent self-service, supports voice automation and helps businesses deliver more responsive customer interactions.


###


Even sophisticated AI agents need a reliable way to communicate with customers over telephone networks. Voice connectivity bridges conversational AI applications and enterprise communications systems, helping organizations deploy AI-powered services through established voice channels.
